verdict.rationale: Paxos's payments docs say merchants can accept PYUSD, USDC and USDP on-chain and choose to automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat instead of holding it [docs-12, docs-13]. USD then settles directly to the merchant's bank [docs-14], backed by a one-call redeem orchestration (stablecoin to USD plus bank withdrawal) and a Fiat Transfers API for wire and CUBIX payouts [docs-9, docs-37]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-conversion and bank settlement work as documented.
